youtube_title: Sneeze When You Look At The Sun? It's A Real Thing | Body Fix #14 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #14. Step out, look at the sun... ACHOO! Every time?
B is right. A REAL reflex: the photic sneeze reflex. It often runs in families.
Bright light triggers eye nerves, the signal spills to your nose. Sneeze.
Fix: Sunglasses when stepping out, riders use a visor. Harmless for most people.
Red flags: Sneezing all day, itchy eyes, blocked nose for weeks or fever? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NIH - Photic sneeze reflex
